descriptions.en: Dependency DAG between Units (directed edges, cycle-free), integration points (APIs/shared data/events), parallel development opportunities (sets of Units with no dependency between them). Topology only, economic path-choice (recommended order, critical path) is 2.9's job. The fenced `yaml` edge block mirrors the DAG and may tag each unit with an optional `kind:` (see [Runtime graph](../13-runtime-graph.md) `bolt_dag.units[].kind`)
